Created out of clinical necessity by renowned veterinarian Dr. Doug Herthel, Platinum Performance® continues to innovate  to best support your health and the health, performance & healing of your horses, dogs & cats. For 30 years Platinum Performance® has lead with focus on exceptional quality & a culture centered on research, standing side-by-side with veterinarians to further the impact of nutrition as a tool & complementary therapy in practice. 

The effects of the Platinum Performance® formulas are studied in colleges of veterinary medicine across the country, & in case studies and feeding trials at equine veterinary practices worldwide. The combination of superior ingredients & scientific rigor supports exceptional results and optimal outcomes. 

(800)553-2400  
www.PlatinumPerformance.com.

Platinum Performance® is in an FDA regulated industry and responsible for posts made by Fans of this page & reserves the right to remove any content that may be interpreted as a disease claim.
